obligations.expected_behavior: Do not count a timeout as expected RED.
forbidden_result: A timeout is classified as expected RED.
A timeout satisfies the expected-RED condition.
obligations.observable_result: The RED execution result records the timeout as not expected RED.
obligations.state_after: The timeout is classified as not expected RED.
obligations.state_before: A timeout occurs during RED execution while the RED outcome is being classified.
obligations.subject: RED execution result classifier
obligations.trigger: A test run times out during RED execution.

obligations.expected_behavior: Classify a zero-case test run as a harness failure.
forbidden_result: A zero-case test run is accepted as a valid RED result.
A zero-case test run is classified as a normal test outcome.
obligations.observable_result: The run outcome is marked as harness failure because zero test cases executed.
obligations.state_after: The zero-case test run is classified as a harness failure.
obligations.state_before: A RED test run completes with zero executed cases and its classification is pending.
obligations.subject: Test harness outcome classifier
obligations.trigger: A test run executes zero cases during RED execution.

obligations.expected_behavior: Do not authorize implementation on the basis of repository noise.
obligations.observable_result: The implementation gate withholds authorization when repository noise is the supporting condition.
obligations.state_after: Repository noise does not authorize implementation.
obligations.state_before: Repository noise is present during RED execution and implementation authorization is pending.
obligations.subject: Implementation authorization gate
obligations.trigger: Repository noise is detected during RED execution.

obligations.expected_behavior: Do not authorize implementation from an unexpected green result.
forbidden_result: An unexpected green result authorizes implementation.
obligations.observable_result: The implementation gate withholds authorization for an unexpected green result.
obligations.state_after: The unexpected green result does not authorize implementation.
obligations.state_before: A green result occurs unexpectedly during RED execution while implementation authorization is pending.
obligations.subject: Implementation authorization gate
obligations.trigger: An unexpected green result occurs during RED execution.

obligations.expected_behavior: Stop another unchanged rerun when the deterministic failure fingerprint is identical for the second occurrence.
forbidden_result: Another unchanged rerun is started after the second identical deterministic failure fingerprint.
obligations.observable_result: The rerun controller halts before launching another unchanged rerun after the second identical fingerprint.
obligations.state_before: One identical deterministic failure fingerprint has already been recorded and a second identical fingerprint is observed during RED execution.
obligations.subject: Deterministic rerun controller
obligations.trigger: A second identical deterministic failure fingerprint is observed during RED execution.
